data.name: Elasticsearch Platform Engineer
data.jobDescription:
UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE TYPE: UK-Highest Level of Government Clearance

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

What’s Your Possible?

At Northrop Grumman UK, you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most – solving tomorrow’s biggest challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. It’s what we call Defining Possible.

This mindset goes beyond what we deliver to our customers; it fuels your growth, your development and the impact you can make within our community.

The Opportunity

This is more than just a job; it’s a mission.

We are seeking an experienced Elasticsearch Platforms Engineer to join our Data Platforms Infrastructure team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, deploying and maintaining our Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) environments, enabling secure, scalable and high‑performing Observability and Search capabilities across mission‑critical systems.

Our UK Cyber and Intelligence business combines modern engineering approaches with decades of Defence sector expertise. Our customers operate in highly sensitive environments and rely on us to deliver resilient, secure and high‑performance technology at scale. This is work that truly matters.

What You Will Do

  • Manage, monitor and maintain Elastic Cloud Enterprise environments, including cluster upgrades, patching and troubleshooting.
  • Design and deploy secure, scalable Elasticsearch solutions for Observability and Search.
  • Implement best‑practice indexing, storage and data retrieval strategies.
  • Apply strong security, privacy and compliance principles across the Elasticsearch ecosystem.
  • Monitor cluster performance and optimise configurations to improve reliability and reduce latency.
  • Work closely with DevOps, Security and Development teams to integrate Elasticsearch with wider platforms.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams and operational procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation and innovation across the Elasticsearch platform.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Strong understanding of Elasticsearch architecture, components, APIs and data indexing.
  • Experience designing and deploying Elasticsearch solutions for Observability and Search.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as GDPR or HIPAA.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g. Python, Bash, Ansible).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, and container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Desirable

  • Experience with Cloudera, Hadoop, Cloudera Data Science Workbench or Cloudera Machine Learning.

If you don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we need, either for this role or another opportunity within Northrop Grumman UK.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must be able to meet the nationality and residency requirements for the highest level of UK Government security clearance.
You must be able to gain and maintain this clearance.
For any questions about the process, our recruitment team can support you: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

Benefits

  • Flexible working options, including a compressed fortnight with every other Friday off
  • Private healthcare
  • Cash health plan
  • Holiday buy/sell
  • Career development and training programmes
  • Performance‑related bonuses

For a full list of benefits, speak with our recruitment team.

Why Join Us?

A Mission to Believe In
Every day we contribute to building a safer, more connected world across land, sea, air, space and cyberspace. What we do together matters.

A Place to Belong and Thrive
Every voice matters at Northrop Grumman UK. You can bring your authentic self to work and be part of an inclusive, supportive community.

Your Career, Your Way
Shape your career with diverse roles, mentorship, development opportunities and support for your wellbeing and long‑term growth.

Ready to apply?

Yes – Submit your application online.
Possibly – Contact us for more information: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com
Not right now – Explore more opportunities with us across the UK.

Northrop Grumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our diverse and inclusive workforce.
